acceptance_repairs.given: A detached positive Probe has independently bound input, actual target, command, result, and output evidence; invalid-package Matrix-Case evidence is also available but is not Probe evidence.
acceptance_repairs.when: The replay verifier evaluates the detached positive Probe and any invalid-package Matrix-Case evidence offered as a substitute.
acceptance_repairs.then: The verifier accepts the detached positive Probe only when its own bound execution has a passing terminal result, and rejects Matrix-Case evidence as a substitute for any required Probe binding.

oracle.observable: The validation result records the positive Probe terminal result and its independently bound input, actual target, command, result, and output evidence, and identifies any absent Probe binding when substitution is attempted.
oracle.expected: The detached positive Probe has a passing terminal result with independently bound input, actual target, command, result, and output evidence; invalid-package Matrix-Case evidence cannot substitute for any of those bindings.
forbidden: A detached positive Probe without a passing terminal result is accepted.
An invalid-package Matrix Case is accepted as proof of the detached Probe oracle.
Matrix-Case evidence alone satisfies a missing detached Probe binding.
